# OpenProxyAI

> OpenProxyAI is an open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted LLM gateway. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for every provider, with policy enforcement, budgets and rate limits, data-class routing, caching, failover, an MCP gateway, evals, SSO and SCIM, and an append-only audit trail.

## Start here
- [Introduction](https://docs.openproxyai.com/getting-started/introduction): what the gateway does
- [Quickstart](https://docs.openproxyai.com/getting-started/quickstart): run it with Docker in minutes
- [Authentication](https://docs.openproxyai.com/getting-started/authentication)
